content: Neha Kapoor sent a HomeShield policy renewal offer to Dev Chatterjee with a 5% loyalty discount, setting the annual premium at $1,250, and requested a signed renewal document. Dev Chatterjee confirmed the terms are acceptable and asked for the payment link, the policy duration after payment, and whether credit card payments are accepted.

action_items: Provide payment link to the customer
Clarify policy activation duration after payment
Confirm if credit card payments are accepted
